request.query: The sum of powers of a nonnegative real number up to n is at most (1 plus that number) to the power n.

items.name: Real.sum_le_exp_of_nonneg
items.type: ∀ {x : ℝ}, 0 ≤ x → ∀ (n : ℕ), ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, x ^ i / ↑i.factorial ≤ Real.exp x

items.name: NNReal.summable_geometric
items.type: ∀ {r : NNReal}, r < 1 → Summable fun n => r ^ n

items.name: Nat.geom_sum_le
items.type: ∀ {b : ℕ}, 2 ≤ b → ∀ (a n : ℕ), ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, a / b ^ i ≤ a * b / (b - 1)

items.name: pow_add_pow_le'
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_3} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : PartialOrder R] [IsOrderedRing R] {a b : R} {n : ℕ},
  0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → a ^ n + b ^ n ≤ 2 * (a + b) ^ n

items.name: tsum_geometric_nnreal
items.type: ∀ {r : NNReal}, r < 1 → ∑' (n : ℕ), r ^ n = (1 - r)⁻¹
